title: Chrome Swagger

authorization.quote: Can you create three more 'surprise me' versions of it please?
authorization.scope: One take per concept, three original instrumental takes total and separate local David previews.

prompt: An original 18-second instrumental futuristic spy-funk advertising cue at 148 BPM, fast, cheeky and stylish, with punchy electronic drums, elastic electric bass, clipped wah-guitar, twangy surf-guitar answers and sharp brass stabs in glossy modern production. Open with a bold brass-and-bass hit, pass a memorable short motif between guitar and brass with changing answers and drum fills every two bars, briefly drop to bass and rim clicks around 7 seconds, then rebuild; keep the lead phrases sparse for a low spoken announcer through 12.5 seconds, followed by an exuberant final hook and a crisp two-hit brass/bass signature ending at 18 seconds. Fully instrumental, newly composed with no sampled recordings, singing, speech, chants, choir or vocal sounds, no long introduction or fade-out.
seed_note: No seed requested; preserve any seed returned.

creative_direction.description: Playful futuristic spy-funk with brass, guitar and punchy electronic drums
creative_direction.user_feedback_addressed: Earlier jingle sounds repetitive during narration; request evolving drums, call-and-response and a brief break rather than one unchanged loop.
creative_direction.reference_usage: Text description only, no reference song uploaded or sampled.

review.checks: MP3 format verified and decoded successfully; preview source/output hashes verified, narration prefix byte-identical to liked metal preview; same source voice gain and fixed master; zero full-scale PCM samples.
review.listening_limitations: Genre, tempo, arrangement development, catchiness and absence of vocal artifacts are requested qualities, not independent assistant listening findings. Approximate source RMS matching is not perceptual LUFS matching or final picture alignment.
review.source_preservation: Locked David, prior music and prior previews remain byte-identical.
review.publication: No final public music share link or contest submission.

local_peak_guard.reason: Initial local render failed fixed-master sample-peak guard before writing audio; lower music only and retain narration level.

user_approval.scope: Lock this exact existing Chrome Swagger music take for the ad; retain the existing David preview as the listening reference. Final picture placement and master mix remain pending.
